cluster_recommendation: This batch is two clusters bolted together. (1) The code-as-harness family (codeact, expel-lesson-extractor, voyager-skill-library, tree-search-coder) is healthy and internally consistent, and every SKILL.md's claimed manifest gate matches agentbox.toml's live value with one exception: voyager-skill-library documents its own gate as `enabled = false` (dormant, Phase-2-pending) when the live toml already has it `true` alongside both its prerequisite gates — a stale status narrative in an otherwise sound skill. (2) The meta-skills (skill-builder, skill-tuning, skill-router) are where the estate's own authoring contract is broken, and because they define/discover everything else, contradictions here propagate estate-wide exactly as the brief warns. skill-builder actively teaches Title-Case names, flat REFERENCE.md/EXAMPLES.md siblings, "no other frontmatter fields recognised", and mandatory `~/.claude/skills/` placement — every one of these is independently and directly falsified: by the agentskills.io open standard (fetched live during this audit), by the vendored ruflo/Codex SKILL.md validator (source read directly: lowercase-hyphen name enforced, version/author/tags recommended as fields — not banned), and by ADR-2021's own lint mechanism (which only recognises a `references/` directory, not flat siblings, for progressive disclosure). The lint's own `ABSPATH_SKIP_DIRS` carve-out for `skill-builder` is corroborating evidence the estate already knows this content is wrong and suppressed the symptom rather than the cause. skill-router's "generated" routing table has no generator anywhere in the tree and is blind to 8 of this batch's 13 skills (including itself) — the estate's one discoverability mechanism for the 106 reference-only skills is silently failing for most of what this audit reviewed. A second, independent finding — codex-registered-skills.txt claims skill-router, lazy-fetch and codebase-memory are Codex-registered, but nothing reconciles that file and live `~/.codex/skills` holds neither of the first two — undermines any GPT-6 Astra-parity claim these skills make. Everything else in the batch (lazy-fetch, codebase-memory, hooks-automation, dream-machine, hermes-scheduler, adaptive-communication) is individually low-risk; the one real cross-cutting gap is that lazy-fetch and hooks-automation both silently own the same Claude-Code-only hook lifecycle with no cross-reference and no stated Codex limitation, and lazy-fetch's own MCP server is unbuilt (no dist/, no node_modules) despite being documented as ready-to-run. Fix order: skill-builder and skill-router first (foundation), then voyager-skill-library's stale gate table, then lazy-fetch's build state plus the lazy-fetch/hooks-automation overlap; skill-tuning's name/layout and adaptive-communication's estate-fit are lower-priority polish.
proposed_contract:
# Skill-Authoring Contract (supersedes skill-builder v1)

## `name`
- Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens only: `/^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/`. No leading/trailing/consecutive hyphens. Max 64 chars.
- MUST equal the parent directory name exactly (agentskills.io spec, verified live; the vendored ruflo/Codex validator enforces the character class today — `services/…/@claude-flow/codex/dist/validators/index.js:216`).

## `description`
- Max 1024 chars, plain text. States WHAT + WHEN (+ WHEN-NOT strongly recommended). Front-load keywords.
- This is the only text always loaded (the 22 registered skills) or matched by skill-router for the other 106 — a trigger contract, not marketing copy.

## Known/allowed frontmatter keys (agentskills.io, verified live 2026-09-09)
- `name`, `description` — required, rules above.
- `license` — optional, short name or pointer to a bundled LICENSE.
- `compatibility` — optional, ≤500 chars. Use this, not prose, to declare cross-harness reach, e.g. `compatibility: "Claude Code only — uses hooks/Skill/Artifact tools"` or `compatibility: "Claude + Codex — CLI-only"`. Verify a claimed Codex registration is actually reconciled into `~/.codex/skills` before writing it.
- `metadata` — optional, FLAT string→string map only (no nested objects). `version`, `author`, `tags`, `category` belong here, or as estate-convention top-level keys (see below) — not invented ad hoc.
- `allowed-tools` — optional, space-separated, experimental.
- Everything else in live estate use (`triggers`, `depends_on_mcps`, `related_skills`, `manifest_gate`, `env_vars`, …) is agentbox-local convention layered on the spec, not part of it. Keep using it where load-bearing (a manifest gate belongs in frontmatter too, not only prose, so it's greppable) — but check SKILL-DIRECTORY.md's existing vocabulary before adding a new key.

## Layout
```
skills/<name>/
  SKILL.md        required; body <500 lines (agentskills.io) / hard-capped 250 by this estate's lint unless references/ exists
  references/     depth: REFERENCE.md, topic files — loaded on demand
  scripts/        executables
  assets/         templates, static resources
```
No `EXAMPLES.md`/`REFERENCE.md` as flat top-level siblings — they live inside `references/`. `skills/lint-skills.mjs`'s BUDGET check only recognises a `references/` directory; flat siblings do not satisfy it once a SKILL.md exceeds 250 lines.

## Location & registration model
- Master copy only: `/home/devuser/workspace/project/agentbox/skills`. Never author directly under `~/.claude/skills/` or `~/.codex/skills/` — those are boot-time symlink/reconciliation targets, not source.
- `registered-skills.txt` → reconciled every boot into `~/.claude/skills/` (Claude Code's always-in-context native Skill list, currently 22 skills). `codex-registered-skills.txt` → NOT currently reconciled by anything (verified: zero script consumers, live `~/.codex/skills` holds only 2 unrelated hand-symlinks) — treat any entry in it as aspirational until a reconciler exists.
- Everything else is reference-only: SKILL-DIRECTORY.md → skill-router (`/route`) → routing-table.md → lazy-fetch. A new skill needs an entry in both SKILL-DIRECTORY.md and routing-table.md or it is undiscoverable except by literal grep.

## Budgets
- Body <500 lines / hard cap 250 without a populated `references/`.
- Registration is a real, permanent per-session token cost — default new skills to reference-only; reserve registration for high-frequency, low-ambiguity skills.

## Lint gate (mandatory pre-rebuild)
`bash skills/lint-skills.sh` checks: banned stale strings; `~/.claude/skills` abspaths; retired `/workspace` paths; a real frontmatter parse (non-empty `name`+`description`); the 250-line/`references/` budget; every cited `references|scripts|assets` path resolves. It does NOT check name format, name==dir, description quality, cross-skill links, model staleness, or duplication (ADR-2021 §Consequences) — a clean lint run is not proof of a well-formed skill.

## Codex / GPT-6 Astra parity
State cross-harness reach explicitly via `compatibility:`. Codex consumes plain SKILL.md text only — no Agent/Skill/Artifact/`/route`/claude-flow-hooks affordances. Do not claim Codex coverage from `codex-registered-skills.txt` alone; confirm the live `~/.codex/skills` symlink exists.
routing_table_generator:
Input: every `skills/*/SKILL.md` frontmatter, parsed with the same real-YAML parser `lint-skills.mjs` already exports (`parseFrontmatter`) — do not write a second bespoke parser. Fields consumed: `name`, `description`, and `category`/`tags`/`related_skills` where present.
Grouping: bucket by an explicit `category:` frontmatter key where present; otherwise fall back via a checked-in static lookup (`skill-router/references/section-map.json`) to the 16 existing routing-table.md sections. The generator must WARN (not silently drop) any skill absent from that lookup.
Output row: `| trigger phrase(s) (from frontmatter `triggers:` or extracted keywords) | -> skill-name | condensed description (≤120 chars, truncated verbatim from frontmatter, never hand-written) |`, grouped by section, alphabetical within section.
Freshness check: emit a manifest of every `skills/*/SKILL.md` name absent from its own output (must be empty for anything in `registered-skills.txt`) and exit non-zero if not.
Wiring: new `scripts/skill-router-gen.mjs`, invoked from `skills/lint-skills.sh` (same pre-rebuild gate) and re-run whenever any `skills/*/SKILL.md` changes.
Until built: skill-router/SKILL.md:87-90 and routing-table.md:1-9 must stop claiming "generated" — replace with "hand-maintained; audit against skills/*/SKILL.md periodically" so the freshness claim stops masking real coverage gaps (8 of this batch's 13 skills currently missing).
